json.reasoning: The request is a two-endpoint transform: the result must open on the entirety of the first supplied picture at 0 ms and close on the entirety of the second supplied picture at 8000 ms, with a slow visual dissolve carrying the change in between. Both pictures are actual frames at their declared anchors, so each is preserved as the complete supplied sheet — hero image on top, the turnaround row in the middle, and the labeled detail crops along the bottom — with all panel labels exactly as supplied. Neither sheet is treated as a subject plate to be cropped or re-staged; the figure in the first sheet and the dragon in the second remain inside their panel layouts. Two shots are pinned: the first holds the first sheet whole, the second performs the slow dissolve and lands exactly on the second sheet at the target endpoint. Camera stays static so the dissolve supplies all visible change. No spoken lines, no visible lettering is added (the existing panel labels belong to the supplied frames), and no replacement is requested, so the replacement map is empty. Creativity is balanced, permitting an unobtrusive score, which the host handles; diegetic ambience stays sparse and tied to the two pictured environments. Style is host-owned and omitted here.

shots.action: The frame opens holding the complete first supplied picture exactly as delivered: a full-sheet character reference layout filling the entire frame. Across the top runs the wide rainy-night hero panel, its dark-clad, scarred adult figure with short dark hair and black high-collared utility jacket and boots standing on wet reflective pavement before metal railings and glowing streetlamps in falling rain. Below it, the full-body turnaround row shows the same figure in front, side-profile and back views on a dark neutral studio ground, and beneath that the row of close detail crops shows the face, the buckled jacket collar, the hands and the lace-up boots. Every panel border, divider and printed panel label remains exactly where the source placed it. Nothing within the sheet moves; only the rain streaks in the hero panel drift and the wet ground shimmers faintly.
subjects: the complete first reference sheet with its hero panel, turnaround row and detail crops
the dark-clad scarred adult figure in black high-collared jacket and combat boots
the rainy nighttime walkway with railings, wet pavement and glowing streetlamps
shots.what_changes: Nothing changes yet; the first supplied sheet is held whole, with only the pictured rain and wet-surface shimmer alive.

shots.action: The held sheet dissolves slowly and evenly, its hero image, panel grid and labels softening and giving way as the second supplied picture rises through it, and the change completes exactly on the whole second sheet filling the frame. The arriving layout carries a wide atmospheric hero view across the top of a massive black dragon, heavily scaled and sheened blue-gray, crouched on four legs with dark membranous wings spread wide, its long pale-horned head lowered and its spined tail trailing across dark volcanic ground under drifting smoke and scattered glowing orange patches. Under that hero view sit the two rows of labeled panels — front, side profile and rear full-body views above head close, wing membrane, claw and foot, and scale detail crops — each divider and printed caption intact and unaltered. By the final instant not a trace of the first sheet remains and the second sheet is present in full, edge to edge.
subjects: the complete second reference sheet with its hero view and two rows of labeled panels
the massive black dragon with pale horns, membranous wings and clawed feet
the dark volcanic terrain with rocky mountains, smoke and glowing orange patches
shots.what_changes: The first sheet dissolves away and is fully replaced by the second supplied sheet, which is complete and exact at the closing instant.
